name: TransactCo
description: A small semantic bridge over the TransactCo operational model. Physical structures are cited; business meaning remains unresolved where the system cannot decide it.

evidence_sources.authority: Current physical Postgres tables, columns, indexes, comments, and deliberately absent constraints.
Current synthetic-data generation behavior and clean-baseline checks.

entities.name: Customer
entities.description: A customer record in the operational store.

entities.name: Product
entities.description: A product record whose price is current rather than historical.

entities.name: Payment
entities.description: A payment attempt or capture received from a PSP webhook.

concepts.name: OrderValue
concepts.description: The amount stored on an order line after the generated discount calculation.

concepts.name: Revenue
concepts.description: A business metric that cannot be defined safely from physical table and column names alone.

questions.question: Which payment and order statuses contribute to revenue?
Is revenue recognized at order, payment, settlement, fulfillment, or another event?
How are refunds, returns, cancellations, discounts, fees, and taxes treated?
Which currency and business-timezone policies govern aggregation?

relationships.subject: Customer
relationships.note: The join path and generator behavior exist, but Postgres does not enforce a foreign key.

relationships.subject: Order
relationships.note: The join path and generator behavior exist, but Postgres does not enforce a foreign key.

relationships.subject: Order
relationships.note: This establishes a physical association, not settlement or revenue recognition.

relationships.subject: Payment
questions: Which statuses and recognition event define inclusion?
How must reversals and commercial adjustments be applied?
relationships.note: Candidate data exists; the business contract does not.

rules.name: NoDeclaredForeignKeys
rules.description: The operational schema deliberately omits foreign-key constraints.

rules.name: CleanBaselinePaymentParity
rules.description: On the generated clean baseline, payment amount is expected to equal order total amount to the cent.

rules.name: BusinessTimeDiffersFromIngestionTime
rules.description: Business timestamps and ingestion timestamps represent different moments and must not be silently substituted.
